name: Wonder Realms
description: Worlds beyond the everyday. Tiny Worlds: shrink to insect size, carve blocks pixel by pixel and trade with the Pixel Miners. Dragons: win eggs from the dragons of the sky islands, raise them, saddle up and fly, breathing fire, frost or lightning, and even hatch the End's Dragon Egg. Sky Islands & Airships: floating islands with dragon roosts, ruins and pillager sky outposts to conquer, and airships to build or capture.
